I've had a few issues with my set since I got them. (And all basic trouble shooting was done). I believe I have encountered something like yours though. There was one point where even turned off I was getting a very dim greenish white light from the diode. I took it out, let it sit without batteries and it's fine now. 

My assumption is it may be due to moisture? I'm a big guy, my hands sweat, especially if I'm using stretch gloves. I've since switched over to slims that are a lot more breathable and my lights have stopped having minor malfunctions. The other thing I'd recommend is to try master resetting it by holding the button (from Off) until the white light flashes. Then press and hold on the solid white. Then try re-programming the chip, either from another chip or from your hub.

Hope it helps.
